item.title: Cassiopeia the Queen reigns in the February sky
item.description: Cassiopeia the Queen is an easy-to-find constellation. It has the shape of a W or M. Look in the northwest, on the evenings, in late winter and early spring. The post Cassiopeia the Queen reigns in the February sky first appeared on EarthSky.

item.title: Milky Way and Andromeda held together by dark matter sheet
item.description: A new computer simulation shows the Milky Way and nearby galaxies are in a sheet of dark matter between 2 voids. Galaxies on the outside fly away from us. The post Milky Way and Andromeda held together by dark matter sheet first appeared on EarthSky.
